# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target

- [A] "invites to conferences" — "concrete invites as a sort of follow-up" tied to "this idea of 42 conferences or events that we're attending," with "the web summit is one of those."
- [A] "the apps are on the app store and that they work and people download them and they like the experience."
- [A] "money commitment" — "meetings with family offices" and "target for follow-up meetings and just money commitments."
- [T] "the number of conversations we have with potential funders... the number per month should be going on an upward trajectory" leading toward "the kind of davos like event."
- [A] "acceptance from more of the academic and standards and these sorts of communities that the hitchhikers are working on something that's genuinely using these things" — e.g. presenting "as a hitchhiker" at "the identity workshop."

**Headline metric.** The number of funder conversations / money commitments per month on "an upward trajectory" — "those interested in being a part of the first patron fish."
